5 days hassle-free return

We kindly request that you record a video of the product unboxing and send it to us on Instagram @lebra.in via DM. Upon receipt and verification of the video, your refund will be processed within 2-3 business days after the package is picked up from you by our delivery partner.
We do not have any final sale policy. All of our items are eligible for return. Feel free to reach out @lebra.in if you're unsure — we’re happy to help!

settings.heading: When will I get my order?

settings.text: Orders are typically processed within 1–2 business days. Once shipped, delivery usually takes 3–7 business days depending on your location. You’ll receive tracking details as soon as your order is on its way.
All our jewelry is thoughtfully crafted in Lucknow, using high-quality materials. We work closely with skilled artisans to ensure every piece meets our design and quality standards.
Shipping is calculated based on your location and the items in your order. You will always know the shipping price before you purchase.
